title: Landing Page Rebuild
description: Rebuild a marketing page section from a screenshot or spec. Tests HTML, CSS, responsive behaviour, and design collaboration.

seo.overviewBody: Landing pages are the primary conversion driver for tech products. Rebuilding a high-conversion landing page tests your mastery of semantic HTML5, CSS layout precision, responsive breakpoints, font & image performance optimization, and conversion-focused Call-to-Action (CTA) design.

deliverables.title: 1. Responsive Layout & Typography Spec
deliverables.desc: Fluid layout design system defining typography scale, mobile-to-desktop breakpoints, and spacing variables.

deliverables.title: 2. Production Landing Page Code
deliverables.desc: Pixel-perfect, responsive landing page featuring hero section, feature cards, social proof testimonials, and pricing table.

deliverables.title: 3. Lighthouse Audit & Optimization Report
deliverables.desc: Performance audit achieving 90+ Lighthouse scores across Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO.

faqs.question: Why is mobile-first CSS development recommended for landing pages?
faqs.answer: Mobile-first CSS ensures light base styles for mobile networks before adding min-width media queries for larger displays, improving mobile page load times and Google indexing priority.

faqs.question: How does image optimization affect hero section LCP scores?
faqs.answer: Using modern WebP/AVIF image formats with explicit priority loading flags prevents layout shifts and guarantees fast Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) rendering on slow mobile connections.

faqs.question: What semantic HTML elements should be used on landing pages?
faqs.answer: Use <header>, <main>, <section> for logical feature blocks, <article> for testimonials/reviews, <aside> for highlight callouts, and <footer> for copyright and footer links.
